About High i.Q.

High i.Q. is an AI-powered growth platform built for real estate agents, mortgage professionals, and brokerages. Our system handles lead outreach, qualification, and follow-up through AI-driven calls, texts, and emails, so our clients spend their time on conversations that matter instead of chasing leads that go cold.

We work with agents, named teams, and brokerage owners across the country. Two of our current sales reps are active real estate agents who were clients first, they liked the system enough that they decided to help sell it. That tells you something about the product.

We're growing and we're building the sales team to keep up with it.

The Role

We're hiring for the setter position with a direct and intentional path into the closer role. Most reps make that transition within 30 to 60 days.

The setter phase isn't a trial period. It's how you earn real money while you learn the product, the process, and how to have the kind of conversations that actually move people. By the time you're running your own demos, you already know the system and you're not figuring it out in front of a prospect.

What You'll Do

As a setter you'll make outbound calls to real estate and mortgage professionals, qualify prospects, and book product demos. You'll work a consistent daily call volume, manage your pipeline in our CRM, and learn how to turn a cold call into a real conversation with someone who actually has a problem you can solve.

As a closer you'll run those demos yourself, walk prospects through the product, and close new clients. Most of our closers self-source the majority of their own appointments which matters significantly for how they get paid.

What the Money Looks Like

We'd rather be straight with you on this than oversell it and have you find out the hard way.

Month 1 will be lean. You're learning the product, learning the prospect, and building your pipeline from scratch. That's normal and expected, it's not a sign that something is wrong.

Our average sale is a $2,000/month subscription with a $1,000 setup fee so $3,000 collected in Month 1. Setters earn 30% of everything collected Month 1, which works out to $900 per deal on average. Residuals are 10% of the monthly subscription so $200 every month that client stays active. Top performers who hit volume thresholds can earn up to 50% on upfront commissions.

Here's what an honest ramp looks like at roughly 80 calls a day. 2 deals in Month 1, 4 in Month 2, 6 in Month 3, and 8 a month from Month 4 forward:

Month 1: ~$1,800 | Month 2: ~$4,000 | Month 3: ~$6,600 | Month 4: ~$9,600 | Month 5: ~$10,800 | Month 6: ~$12,000

Six-month total: ~$44,800. Annualized run rate by month 6: ~$144,000 per year, and that number keeps climbing every month your active clients renew.

Every client you close keeps paying monthly. You earn 10% of their subscription every month they stay active without doing anything additional to earn it. That base doesn't reset. It compounds.

Most reps move into the closer role within 30 to 60 days of hitting their stride as a setter. When that happens your commission rate increases significantly. Closers can earn 75% upfront on deals they source and close themselves and every residual you built as a setter carries over. The base you built in months one through three keeps paying you in month six, month twelve, and beyond on top of whatever you close in the closer role.

This is not a role where your check resets to zero on the first of the month.

What You Need

A computer and reliable internet. The discipline to work a consistent daily process without someone managing your calendar. The confidence to pick up the phone and have real conversations with business owners who didn't ask you to call.

You don't need a tech background. You do need a basic understanding of real estate or mortgage or the drive to get there fast. If you've sold to agents, brokers, or loan officers before, that's a real advantage.

The Honest Part

Real estate and mortgage professionals are sitting on databases full of leads their teams can't physically call fast enough. They're losing serious money every month not because the leads aren't there but because there aren't enough hours in the day to work them. When you can show someone what that inaction is actually costing them and then show them a solution that runs on autopilot for a few thousand dollars a month, most conversations aren't complicated.

What is hard is the daily volume. Making the calls, working the process consistently, and staying in long enough for the residuals to start compounding. Most people wash out before month 3. If that's not you, the math above is real and it only goes in one direction.

How to Apply

Call us. 719-312-6500.

If you're serious about this, that's your first move. Not a resume drop. A phone call. If you're going to be making outbound calls every day on our behalf, picking up the phone right now is a reasonable place to start.

Want to take a look at what we do before making the call? Check us out at https://highiq.io/
